# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m152 UAF fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 bumps to a Skia m152 build with a use-after-free fix.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

- **Skia updated with a Chrome m152 UAF fix** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to pick up an upstream Chrome m152 use-after-free fix. ([#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))
